name: pi
doc: pi (pi.dev coding agent): reaches every vendor except the five that own a CLI (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, xAI), like opencode. Model ids are `provider/id` as `pi --list-models` prints them (opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro, openrouter/... :free ids). Credentials live in $PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/auth.json (default ~/.pi/agent), so a second login is another directory (~/.pi/agent-b, standard <default>-<letter>). `-p` is non-interactive; `--approve` trusts the project's local files; sessions stay on disk because the token report reads them.

usage.note: pi has no usage command. Its opencode-go provider spends the same OpenCode Go allowance (rolling 5 h, weekly, monthly) as opencode, so the probe asks opencode for the default account's limits. Other providers (OpenRouter :free) have no tracked window.

coordinator_env_doc: variables this CLI sets in the processes it starts: when one is set, the coordinator session runs on this CLI, on the account its account_env names in this process (unset = default home). AUTOPILOT_COORDINATOR=<cli>[/<account>] overrides.
